verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents broad programmatic coverage: connected accounts, transfers, billing and invoicing, refunds and webhooks. Its CLI and AgentOS MCP expose read and write access to production resources such as balances, beneficiaries and cards. However, the CLI explicitly covers only "a broad slice" of the API, and nothing claims full parity with the web app. Webhook delivery inspection and re-delivery are described only as web-app features. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, evidence that UI-only operations like webhook re-delivery are API-accessible, and independent hands-on corroboration of coverage.
